name: @pipeworx/mcp-cataas

tools.name: random_cat
tools.description: Get a random cat image. Returns image URL, cat ID, and associated tags.

tools.name: cat_by_tag
tools.description: Get a random cat image matching a specific tag (e.g., 'orange', 'cute', 'sleepy'). Returns image URL, cat ID, and tags.

tag.description: Tag to filter cats by (e.g. "cute", "orange", "grumpy"). Use list_tags to see available tags.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all available cat tags for filtering. Use tag names with cat_by_tag to find cats by appearance or behavior.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cataas forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cataas pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
